specs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready 2D pixel game animation sprite sheet.
Generate ONE PNG, exactly 1536 pixels wide x 1024 pixels high, with a genuinely transparent alpha background. Arrange exactly 24 full-body sprites in a rigid invisible grid of SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows. Each grid cell is exactly 256 x 256 pixels. Cell centers are x=128,384,640,896,1152,1408 and y=128,384,640,896. No text, row labels, cell borders, grid lines, shadows, props, scenery, background color or checkerboard.
Use the supplied image as an identity and palette REFERENCE only. Draw only the specified target character repeated across all 24 cells, excluding all other characters in the reference. Preserve the target's exact recognizable face, body proportions, colors and signature details. Do not redesign or simplify into a generic geometric mascot.
Style: high-quality crisp low-resolution pixel sprites with visible carefully placed clustered square pixels, approximately 96 pixels of underlying sprite resolution enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor edges. No blur, anti-aliasing or smooth vector art. Full body stays fully inside every cell, maximum sprite width and height 210 pixels with generous empty margins. Keep consistent size, proportions and pivot; standing feet share a consistent baseline within each row. Mostly facing right in a three-quarter front view. Animation walks in place, with no horizontal drift.
Animation order LEFT TO RIGHT:
ROW 1 (top 0-255): six IDLE frames forming a seamless loop. Subtle breathing and head movement with stationary feet. Eyes open in frames 1,2,5,6; blink through frames 3 and 4.
ROW 2 (y=256-511): six distinct TRUE WALK cycle frames forming a seamless loop, ordered left-foot contact, left-foot down, right-leg passing, right-foot contact, right-foot down, left-leg passing. Alternate left and right foot visibly forward/back. Clear changing bent knee/feet, opposite arm swing, and appropriate tail/hair motion. Walk in place. Preserve the same character scale in all six frames.
ROW 3 (y=512-767): six TALK frames in a consistent upright stance. Mouth sequence closed, small opening, large opening, small opening, closed, small opening. Subtle eyebrow changes and restrained hand/foreleg gestures.
ROW 4 (bottom y=768-1023): six SLEEP frames in the same resting/crouched seated pose, head lowered and eyes closed. Gentle belly/chest breathing across the six frames. No Z letters, no pillow, no props. Keep consistent scale and resting baseline. Each row must loop smoothly.
The sheet must contain exactly SIX sprites per row and FOUR rows, every cell populated, nothing cropped, no extra characters. Preserve genuine transparent alpha.
